name: Xi Xue Dong Jian
source:
The story takes place in a fantasy world called Evilia, where peaceful indigenous people - elves and predators from outer space - lizards have fought a life-and-death battle. Fortunately, the invaders failed to defeat the indomitable struggle of the elves; unfortunately, the elves did not have enough power to completely drive out the invaders from their homeland. Players will play as a principal of an interstellar communication college, seizing a strange but rare strategic opportunity period, and striving to balance various forces and ideologies in a treacherous situation. Players can sincerely accept the guidance of the advanced civilization of lizards with open hearts; they can seek peace cautiously, growing in strength while dancing with wolves; or they can shatter this false illusion, defeat the conspiracy of lizards, and reignite the raging flames of war.

[From [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2544620/]Steam[/url]]
translation:
在幻想世界伊芙利亚，爱好和平的原住民精灵曾与来自太空的掠夺者蜥蜴人殊死交战。幸运的是，精灵顽强抵抗，侵略者没能取胜。不幸的是，精灵也无力将入侵者彻底逐出家园。如今，局势险恶，一个不同寻常却难得的战略机会也随之出现。你将担任一所星际交流学院的校长，在各方势力和思潮之间维持平衡。你可以真心接受蜥蜴人先进文明的指引，也可以谨慎谋求和平，在与狼共舞时壮大自身；或者索性戳破眼前的假象，挫败蜥蜴人的阴谋，再次点燃战火。
